decisions.reason: As an adjacent consumer-health supplement with low carrying costs and two years of dedicated web presence, it is still a relatively cheap option to keep open while the firm broadens its portfolio.
This skin-and-hair supplement fits the firm's consumer-health expansion and showed enough initial commitment to justify continued market presence while its full demand potential is assessed.
The move from a website mention to a standalone page suggests improving internal commitment, and as a close-to-core supplement it is inexpensive to retain as an option.
Its progression to a dedicated page and the still-uncertain upside of immune-support products make it worthwhile to keep this low-cost adjacent option alive.
For a more distant product, the early problem signal and only limited subsequent visibility indicate that enough downside has been revealed to stop committing resources.
This more distant OTC medicine showed only launch-year visibility and no clear follow-through, so the option value appears weaker than alternative uses of resources.
